2 Importing Data

2.1 Loading Master Plan2019 Subzone Boundary NoSea KML

mpsz <- st_read("data/geospatial/MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaKML.kml")
Reading layer `URA_MP19_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL' from data source

  using driver `KML'
Simple feature collection with 332 features and 2 fields
Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 103.6057 ymin: 1.158699 xmax: 104.0885 ymax: 1.470775
Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84
extract_kml_field <- function(html_text, field_name) {
  if (is.na(html_text) || html_text == "") return(NA_character_)
  
  page <- read_html(html_text)
  rows <- page %>% html_elements("tr")
  
  value <- rows %>%
    keep(~ html_text2(html_element(.x, "th")) == field_name) %>%
    html_element("td") %>%
    html_text2()
  
  if (length(value) == 0) NA_character_ else value
}
mpsz <- mpsz %>%
  mutate(
    REGION_N = map_chr(Description, extract_kml_field, "REGION_N"),
    PLN_AREA_N = map_chr(Description, extract_kml_field, "PLN_AREA_N"),
    SUBZONE_N = map_chr(Description, extract_kml_field, "SUBZONE_N"),
    SUBZONE_C = map_chr(Description, extract_kml_field, "SUBZONE_C")
  ) %>%
  select(-Name, -Description) %>%
  relocate(geometry, .after = last_col())

2.4 PLotting map

tm_shape(mpsz)+ tm_polygons()+ tm_shape(BusStop)+ tm_dots()

3 Extracting bus stop within Singapore

BusStop_in_SG <- st_join(
  BusStop, mpsz,
  join = st_within,
  left = FALSE
)

Check again

tm_shape(mpsz)+ tm_polygons()+ tm_shape(BusStop_in_SG)+ tm_dots()

We can find that all bus stops are within Singapore

4 Derving Analytical Hexagon

hexagon <- st_make_grid(mpsz,
  cellsize = 700,
  what = "polygon",
  square = FALSE
) %>%
  st_sf()

In Hands on exercise check whether cell size= 700 really means 375 meters in hexagon as required by Hands-on- Exercise

5 Filtering hexagons with bus stops

hexagon$n_collisions = 
  lengths(st_intersects(
    hexagon, BusStop_in_SG
  ))

hexagon <- filter(hexagon, n_collisions > 0)

6 Assigning ids to each hexagon

hexagon <- hexagon %>%
  select(-n_collisions)

hexagon$HEX_ID <- sprintf(
  "H%04d", seq_len(nrow(hexagon))
) %>%
  as.factor()

7 Preparing Trip Generation Data

7.1 Cleaning the data

Remove unnecessary column and aggregate

trips <- odbus %>%
  select(c(ORIGIN_PT_CODE, DAY_TYPE, TIME_PER_HOUR, TOTAL_TRIPS)) %>%
  rename(BUS_STOP_N = ORIGIN_PT_CODE) %>%
  rename(HOUR_OF_DAY = TIME_PER_HOUR) %>%
  rename(TRIPS = TOTAL_TRIPS)

trips$BUS_STOP_N <- as.factor(trips$BUS_STOP_N)

kable(head(trips))

7.2 Combine

bs_hex <- st_intersection(
  BusStop, hexagon
) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(c(BUS_STOP_N, HEX_ID))
